readout.auction_text: Closing auction window — auction imbalance is a different number, not shown here.

detail.books: NYSE_BOOK is each exchange's best quote grouped by price, not order depth. NASDAQ_BOOK carries Nasdaq's own quote and market makers' quotes.
detail.construction: Composite: every exchange's and market maker's quote from both books, codes matched without regard to case, one per contributor by side, price and code; NSDQ once, from NYSE_BOOK; then the best five distinct prices per side. Never the two books' level totals summed, never NSDQ's two sizes averaged, never the newer book's copy kept.
detail.nsdq: NSDQ is counted once, from NYSE_BOOK, by convention. The two books disagree on NSDQ's size in 82.5% of strict pairs (Nov 2 session), and the data cannot say which size is right. The composite headline is a conventional number, not a verified one.
detail.spans: Top 5 covers different price ranges on the two venues — the percentages are over different prices, so compare directions, not magnitudes. The touch is the only like-for-like comparison across venues.
detail.weights: Headline weights by price level from the touch: 0.43, 0.26, 0.16, 0.10, 0.06 (exp(-0.5·(k-1)), normalized; renormalized over the levels a thin side has). Starting weights from a vendor study (VisualHFT, touch-weighted), adjustable.
detail.zones: Zones, a provisional guide and not a research finding: BALANCED under 10% (Bookmap's colour-switch line); BID or OFFER HEAVY from 10% to under 70%; VERY ONE-SIDED from 70% (a VisualHFT vendor study, not a peer-reviewed paper). The middle range grades direction only, not strength. The headline is the median of the last 5 seconds; a zone changes after 3 seconds across its line; a flip is a change of side, bid to offer or back, held that long; 5 or more flips in 2 minutes read CHOPPY.
